choices.content: The sample size is too large
People sampled at a library entrance may read more than other residents, so the survey may overestimate reading time and lacks representativeness
There is no problem because the people were stopped randomly
Only elderly people should be surveyed

question.prompt: A student wants to find out how much time residents across a city spend reading each day. The student randomly stops 100 readers at a library entrance to survey them. The main problem with this survey is

solutions.explanation: Sampling only people at a library entrance excludes many residents and does not give a representative sample of the city. People in this sample may read more, so the survey may overestimate average reading time; an overestimate is not guaranteed.
solutions.title: Check coverage of the target population
